body:
## Summary

- Updates Sepo agent infrastructure from **v0.2.0** to **v0.3.0** (bec597687fdb1a1786e7127ee6ddd5ec088f36af)
- Syncs `.agent/` source (TypeScript, docs, templates) and all `.github/` agent workflows/actions/prompts
- Key new capability: model policy / model selection support (`AGENT_MODEL_POLICY`, `model` and `reasoning_effort` outputs from `resolve-agent-provider`, `model`/`display_model` inputs to `run-agent-task`)

## Source

- **Source repo/ref:** `self-evolving/repo@v0.3.0`
- **Source SHA:** `bec597687fdb1a1786e7127ee6ddd5ec088f36af`
- **Target branch:** `main`

## Audit Summary

| Path group | Status |
|---|---|
| `.agent/` (src, docs, templates, package.json) | ✅ Safe replace — all agent-owned |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/action.yml` | ✅ Safe replace — agent-owned; switches to `resolve-provider.js` |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js` | ✅ New file added |
| `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml` | ✅ Safe replace — agent-owned |
| `.github/workflows/*.yml` (18 files updated) | ✅ Safe replace — all agent-owned |
| `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.sh` | ⚠️ Preserved (now superseded by `.js`; obsolete-file removal not requested) |
| `.gitignore` | ✅ Already contains `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/` entries — no change needed |
| `agent/memory` branch | ✅ Exists — no reinit needed |
| `agent/rubrics` branch | ✅ Exists — no reinit needed |

## Customizations Preserved

- `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.sh` — kept (unused after this update; safe to delete later if desired)
- All target-only `.github/` files (e.g. `agent-approve.yml`, `agent-branch-cleanup.yml`, etc.) — untouched

## Removed Files

None (obsolete-file removal was not requested for this run).

## Validation Results

- `npm --prefix .agent ci` — ✅ passed
- `npm --prefix .agent run build` — ✅ passed (TypeScript compilation clean)
- `npm --prefix .agent test` — ✅ 686/686 tests passed, 0 failed
- YAML syntax check for all `.github/workflows/*.yml` — ✅ all 25 files valid
- `git diff --check` (whitespace) — ✅ clean

## Memory / Rubrics Branch Status

- `agent/memory` — ✅ exists at `559fc56e470e6fc087b6c58b382513a4dc2a316b`
- `agent/rubrics` — ✅ exists at `b532a696f8c2fcfe6314068b49a50f7eaad602dd`

## Post-Merge Notes

1. No secrets changes required — existing auth paths are unchanged.
2. **New optional secrets:** `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` (JSON) can now be set as a repository secret/variable to configure model selection and reasoning effort per route. Not required; defaults apply if absent.
3. `resolve-provider.sh` is now unused and can be deleted via a follow-up PR if desired.
4. Smoke test after merge: open an issue and mention `@sepo-agent /answer` to verify the updated runtime.
title: Update Sepo from v0.2.0 to v0.3.0/bec597687fdb1a1786e7127ee6ddd5ec088f36af
